submission.justification: Radiator-R2 at 3 cm thickness provides the best pion/kaon separation performance at 10 GeV/c with 4.6 sigma separation. This is significantly better than the alternatives: R3 achieves 3.8 sigma at 3 cm (21% lower), and R1 achieves only 2.9 sigma at 3 cm (37% lower). The simulation systematically evaluated all three radiator candidates across the full thickness range (1-6 cm), and R2 at 3 cm emerged as the clear optimal choice for hadron identification. This configuration meets all project constraints while maximizing the physics performance goal.
